description: This file defines the interface for the TextReader class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. It includes class declarations, constructors, methods for reading text lines, and internal data members. It also includes licensing information and includes other local header files.

classes.name: TextReader
classes.description: A class for reading text data from a DataElement, with methods to reset, check end of text, and read lines.

methods.name: TextReader()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing index to zero and data block to empty.

methods.name: TextReader(DataElement& element, const uint32_t offset = 0)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the data block with a DataElement and setting the starting index.

methods.name: operator=(const TextReader& rhs)
methods.description: Assignment operator copying index and data block.

methods.name: Reset()
methods.description: Resets the reading position to the beginning.

methods.name: EndOfText() const
methods.description: Checks if the reading position has reached or exceeded the size of the data block.

methods.name: ReadLine() const
methods.description: Reads a line of text from the data block.
